title: John Paul II Texture Pack
description: The Ultimate John Paul II Texture Pack.
body:
John Paul II has always been watching over us, so let's take a look at him now in a Minecraft resource pack!

That texture pack contains nothing but tidbits related to John Paul II. The Polish Pope.

TOTEM MODEL WAS TAKEN FROM: Dulan
